sources.summary: Spanish designer Isern Serra has used rounded corners and curved built-in furniture to create a "relaxed and welcoming atmosphere" inside Napoli on the Road, a pizza restaurant in London's Soho area. The central London restaurant has a pared-back, architectural interior that was inspired by chef Michele Pascarella's Italian roots.
